name: cliamp
description: cliamp radio in Claude Code: sidebar with favorites, search and discovery, mini player, song log, focus mode, ducking and a radio tool for Claude

statusline.title: Status line
statusline.description: What the status line shows: full, title, spectrum or off (the mini player above the prompt shows it already)

duckOnAsk.title: Quieter on permission prompts
duckOnAsk.description: Off by default. Lower the volume by 12 dB while Claude waits for your approval

dipOnTurnEnd.title: Dip when a turn ends
dipOnTurnEnd.description: Off by default. A short volume dip as a signal that Claude has finished

autostart.title: Start the daemon on demand
autostart.description: Start cliamp --daemon when the sidebar opens or a station is chosen

moods.title: Moods
moods.description: mood=station pairs for /cliamp mood, separated by ;
